description: List the EditAtlas skills, or get one. A skill is a folder of instructions and scripts that runs a whole step on the user's machine, for example sound-design places library sounds on a finished video and checks sync and loudness, and transcribe makes a checked word-level transcript with Whisper for captions and cuts. Without name you get every skill, or only those for one library. With name you get its install and update steps for Claude Code, Claude apps and other agents, links pinned to the released version, and, with include_instructions, its SKILL.md text.

include_instructions.description: Also return the SKILL.md body. Use it when you cannot install the skill and will follow it by hand

library.description: Only skills that use this EditAtlas library; studio is the EditAtlas Studio, where the person edits a project in the browser

name.description: Skill name from the list, such as sound-design

name: get_skill
